- Follow motion now also carries the scramble backward from the next refresh, as in bidirectional texture advection (Bousseau et al., 2007), and compares the flow in both directions to find where content is covered or uncovered. The scramble follows motion more closely and no longer streaks at the edges of moving objects. With pixel and block scrambling, moving areas now stay as sharp as the rest of the frame. With diffeomorphic and local phase scrambling, the warp or the random phase now moves with the content, and every frame is a scramble of that frame alone. Processing takes about 1.5 times as long. See [docs/methods.md](https://github.com/altunenes/scramblery/blob/main/docs/methods.md).
- Updated the ONNX Runtime bindings (ort 2.0.0-rc.15), which fix several memory safety issues.

CUDA builds need CUDA 13 and cuDNN 9, OpenVINO builds need Intel OpenVINO, and MIGraphX builds need ROCm. On Linux, use the `.deb` for GPU. See [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/altunenes/scramblery/blob/main/INSTALL.md).
